note: Couch 1.0.6 App Review pass. Add a TV now offers "Try a demo TV" while no TV is saved, so Couch can be tried without a TV (demo apps are Couch's own abstract tiles, no streaming logos). The voice key says "Search on the TV" and opens the keyboard on TVs without voice (all real TVs today) instead of "Hold to talk"; the Couch Plus screen no longer lists voice. Add a TV no longer shows a "beta" chip on Fire TV (Couch can't control Fire TV yet and says so plainly). No purchase, permission or service changes.
